postload_actions.speaker: IT GUY
postload_actions.text: Erm... perhaps if you were to try rebooting in safe mode...

default_actions.text: B-but he's currently trapped inside of a cage!
default_actions.cage: I didn't misspell ANYTHING! Not once, not one time!

default_actions.speaker: NETFEAR ROUTER
default_actions.text: Tell you what. Your frustration amuses me, so I'll let you take Another Stab.

default_actions.speaker: PACHINKO MAN

default_actions.text: Aw, you're no fun anymore.

default_actions.speaker: MR. D's PC
default_actions.text:
*ding* 
 Welcome! 
 You've got mail!

default_actions.speaker: MR. DRACHENROE
default_actions.text: Well IT Guy, it took you long enough, but I guess incarceration finally motivated you to fix my computer. I guess you can go now.

default_actions.speaker: IT GUY
default_actions.text: At last! Sweet freedom!

default_actions.speaker: MR. DRACHENROE
default_actions.text: By the way, there's a projector broken in one of the conference rooms. You'd better go and fix that right away.

default_actions.speaker: IT GUY
default_actions.text:
* SIGH * 
 You'd hope it would last a mite longer.

default_actions.speaker: MR. DRACHENROE
default_actions.text: As for you, other... guy... Pachinko man-ball thing... I'm in a good mood! So I'll let you leave here alive.

default_actions.speaker: MR. DRACHENROE
default_actions.text: Provided you do so RIGHT NOW. And never come into my office uninvited EVER AGAIN.

default_actions.speaker: PACHINKO MAN
default_actions.text: Y-yes sir...
default_actions.cage: WHAT? I'll be ARRESTED? Put in AIRPORT JAIL?

default_actions.speaker: NETFEAR ROUTER
default_actions.text:
SIGNAL STRENGTH: Excellent 
 ...don't worry, I'll find a way to muck it up again before too long.

default_actions.speaker: PACHINKO MAN
default_actions.text: It looks like Drachenroe has one of your PA systems in his office, Baal.

default_actions.speaker: BAAL
default_actions.text: OH THAT'S JUST DRACHENROE'S 'PHENOMENAL APTITUTDE' AWARD. FOR EXEMPLARY DESPOTISM.

default_actions.speaker: BAAL
default_actions.text: IF YOU HAD ANY APTITUDE WHATSOEVER YOU MIGHT HAVE RECOGNIZED IT.

default_actions.speaker: PACHINKO MAN
default_actions.text: That's strange... there's a showerhead above Drachenroe's computer.

default_actions.speaker: BAAL
default_actions.text: LOOKS LIKE A FANCY EYE-WASHING STATION! BETTER STUFF YOUR FACE INTO IT.

default_actions.speaker: IT GUY
default_actions.text: Actually, that's a blood-based coolant system. But it seems to be blocked off somehow...

default_actions.speaker: PACHINKO MAN
default_actions.text: This is new... I guess plugging that leak in the bathroom also fixed this blood shower. Yuck!

default_actions.speaker: BAAL
default_actions.text: OH YOU ARE SUCH THE PRUDE! WE'VE ALL GOT BLOOD SHOWERS INSIDE OUR BODY, Y'KNOW.

default_actions.speaker: BAAL
default_actions.text: PRETTY SOON YOU WILL HAVE ONE OUTSIDE OF YOUR BODY. IF YOU DON'T GET BACK TO WORK, I MEAN.

default_actions.speaker: MR. D'S PC
default_actions.text:
The popups... the spyware... the 36 brands of anti-virus software... it's all too much to take! 
 I need some kind of relief...!

default_actions.speaker: MR. D'S PC
default_actions.text: Ahh, sweet relief! I'm raring to crunch spreadsheets again...

default_actions.speaker: PACHINKO MAN
default_actions.text: Nghh... can't quite make out what's on the monitor from this angle.

default_actions.speaker: IT GUY
default_actions.text: Oh! My involuntary vantage point may come in handy here.

default_actions.speaker: IT GUY
default_actions.text: At the moment, the computer is utterly unresponsive. Nothing to speak of but the odd blue screen!

default_actions.speaker: MR. DRACHENROE
default_actions.text:
This BLUE screen... has got me SEEING RED! 
 So it's BASICALLY A PURPLE SCREEN! 
 And I'm NOT OKAY WITH THAT!

default_actions.speaker: IT GUY
default_actions.text: Dear me! The machine has cooled down and got to running properly again. But it seems Drachenroe is still having a spot of trouble...

default_actions.speaker: MR. DRACHENROE
default_actions.text:
Double you double you double you dot... 
 What's a Wee-Fee password? Why can't I enter my webzones? WHERE IS MY SOCIAL NETSCAPE?!

default_actions.speaker: MR. DRACHENROE
default_actions.text: Alright. Exactly who or what are you supposed to be?

default_actions.speaker: PACHINKO MAN
default_actions.text: Er... I suppose I'm... a Pachinko Man?

default_actions.speaker: MR. DRACHENROE
default_actions.text: Okay. So when exactly did you schedule the appointment? The appointment for speaking to me right now?

default_actions.speaker: PACHINKO MAN
default_actions.text: Er... your receptionist just let me in... but I thought I could -

default_actions.speaker: MR. DRACHENROE
default_actions.text: Alright, LISTEN UP, you JERK. I am BEHIND on accounts, BEHIND on analytics, and I CAN'T BLOG ON TO MY TWEET-MAILS.

default_actions.speaker: MR. DRACHENROE
default_actions.text: And I will LITERALLY kill my receptionist for thinking I have ever - IN THIS LIFE - had time to waste on an unemployed DORK like YOU!

default_actions.speaker: PACHINKO MAN
default_actions.text: B-but - I'm not unemployed - !
default_actions.cage: This is murder... MURDER! YOU'LL ALL BE GUILTY!

default_actions.speaker: MR. DRACHENROE
default_actions.text: ARE YOU SURE?! BECAUSE YOU'RE ABOUT TO GET... FIRED!!!

default_actions.epitaph: YOU WERE ENVELOPED IN A DRAGON'S FIERY BREATH AND MELTED TO A PUDDLE... NOT AN UNCOOL WAY TO GO, TBH.

default_actions.speaker: PACHINKO MAN
default_actions.cage: This is murder... MURDER! YOU'LL ALL BE GUILTY!

default_actions.speaker: MR. DRACHENROE
default_actions.text: Y'KNOW, I DID WARN YOU.

default_actions.epitaph: YOU WERE ENVELOPED IN A DRAGON'S FIERY BREATH AND MELTED TO A PUDDLE... NOT AN UNCOOL WAY TO GO, TBH.

lens.speaker: MR. DRACHENROE'S THOUGHTS
lens.text: Hrmm, what was my password for this computer... was it 'HOW DOES THIS THING WORK HELLO'? Nah, that's my bank password...

lens.speaker: MR. DRACHENROE'S THOUGHTS
lens.text:
Wait, why am I thinking about this? Don't I PAY people to remember these things for me? 
 WHY HAVE THOSE PEOPLE FAILED ME?!

lens.speaker: MR. DRACHENROE'S THOUGHTS
lens.text: Now that my webzones are restored, I can resume my all-important task... OF LOOKING UP PICTURES OF CATS.

hatemail.speaker: MR. DRACHENROE
hatemail.text: You realize I'm going to kill you purely for wasting my time with this, right?

hatemail.speaker: PACHINKO MAN
hatemail.text:
*sigh* 
 I kind of had an idea, yeah.

default_actions.speaker: IT GUY
default_actions.text: Come to get some computer help, have you? Well, I'm afraid you'll need to wait in line. See that great dragon over there?

default_actions.speaker: PACHINKO MAN
default_actions.text: H-he's sort of hard to miss...
default_actions.cage: What are these IGUANAS doing on my coffee table?

default_actions.speaker: IT GUY
default_actions.text: Right? He's one fiery dragon you DON'T want to pull by the tail - a real titan of terror!

default_actions.speaker: IT GUY
default_actions.text: And he's refused to release me from this prison until I can tell him how to fix the 'mail-zone' on his 'web-box'.

default_actions.speaker: MR. DRACHENROE
default_actions.text: I'M PRESSING EVERY KEY AND NOTHING IS HAPPENING!

default_actions.speaker: PACHINKO MAN
default_actions.text: It doesn't sound like he'll be very receptive to your instructions.

default_actions.speaker: IT GUY
default_actions.text: Listen, I don't know who you are, but you've got to serve as my proxy out there and troubleshoot Drachenroe into submission.

default_actions.speaker: IT GUY
default_actions.text: The fate of tech support itself hangs in the balance...

default_actions.speaker: PACHINKO MAN
default_actions.text: The IT Guy is free now! Good for him.

default_actions.speaker: BAAL
default_actions.text: EXACTLY! HE'S FREE TO TOIL ENDLESSLY FOR NO PAY HERE IN GOOD OL' BALL HELL.

default_actions.speaker: PACHINKO MAN
default_actions.text: ...maybe I shouldn't think too hard about this.

default_actions.speaker: PACHINKO MAN
default_actions.text: You know, something occurred to me since we last spoke.
default_actions.cage: You think there's a lot of, uh, lot of anger flowing around this island?

default_actions.speaker: IT GUY
default_actions.text: What would that be, my pearl-shaped pal?

default_actions.speaker: PACHINKO MAN
default_actions.text: I KNOW ABSOLUTELY NOTHING ABOUT TECH SUPPORT.

default_actions.speaker: IT GUY
default_actions.text: Well, you're in the thick of the crunch now, mate. There's no better time to learn.

default_actions.speaker: IT GUY
default_actions.text: You ought to cross-examine the devices, diagnose their problems, and track down their sources.

default_actions.speaker: PACHINKO MAN
default_actions.text: That's, um, pretty vague. Do you have any specific IT knowledge that could help me?

default_actions.speaker: IT GUY
default_actions.text: Oh! And try turning the computer off and then back on again.

default_actions.speaker: IT GUY
default_actions.text: ...that's about the best I've got.

rope.speaker: IT GUY
rope.text: Brilliant! I could use that rope as a ladder and climb down to freedom! If it weren't for, you know, the iron bars.

scissors.speaker: IT GUY
scissors.text: Uhh, I don't think those scissors will break these bars. You'd be better off dealing with this in an orthodox manner.

lens.speaker: IT GUY'S THOUGHTS
lens.text: Eh? What type of magnifying glass is that luddite waving 'round the room? Is he look for clues?

lens.speaker: IT GUY'S THOUGHTS
lens.text: If that's how he conducts an investigation, I expect he'll have as much luck as a Kadinsky-Weiler search algorithm.

lens.speaker: IT GUY'S THOUGHTS
lens.text: And that algorithm is particularly ineffective!

default_actions.speaker: PACHINKO MAN
default_actions.text: Th-that computer has burst into flames!
default_actions.cage: HOW'D IT GET BURNED? HOW'D IT GET BURNED?!

default_actions.speaker: BAAL
default_actions.text: UHH, YEAH? THIS IS HELL, THE MAJORITY OF OBJECTS YOU ENCOUNTER SHOULD BY ALL RIGHTS BE ON FIRE.

default_actions.speaker: IT GUY
default_actions.text: Erm, sorry - this seems like a classic case of overheating. We need to find a way to cool the case down!

default_actions.text: MAYBE YOU SLOUCHERS HAD BETTER COOL YOURSELVES DOWN. HUH? GET OFFA MY CASE.
